description: List broken internal links (destination URL, the source page linking to it, and when Yandex last checked the link). Records can be months old: `source_last_access_date` equal to `discovery_date` means the link has NOT been re-verified since the problem was found, so it may already be fixed. Such records are flagged `stale` / "never re-checked" — verify before treating the count as a live failure. Use when the user asks which internal links look broken and whether Yandex has rechecked them. Do not use it for the count over time; call get-broken-internal-links-history. Do not use it for links from other sites; call get-external-links.
name: get-broken-internal-links
